_comment: Researched 2026-11-06 from public pricing pages and third-party summaries. Prices change often: confirm on the provider's own pricing page before approving any spend. Rates are USD per generated second of video.

services.name: Kling 3.0 Omni (reference-to-video, 1080p, silent)
services.notes: Native 10 s clips match the plan exactly; character references for continuity. Rate is one provider's published figure; official direct pricing may be lower.

services.name: Kling 3.0 (text/image-to-video, 720p, silent, official baseline)
services.notes: Cheapest native 10 s option; 720p must be upscaled to 1080p; weaker continuity than reference mode.

services.name: Google Veo 3.1 Fast (1080p)
services.notes: 8 s per generation: each 10 s shot needs an extension, so cost includes extra seconds.

services.name: Google Veo 3.1 Standard (1080p)
services.notes: Top quality, highest cost; same 8 s limit.

services.name: Runway Gen-4.5 (720p)
services.notes: API credits billed separately from app subscriptions; 720p must be upscaled.

unavailable.name: OpenAI Sora 2 / Sora 2 Pro
unavailable.reason: OpenAI discontinued the Sora app (April 2026) and API (reported 24 Sept 2026).
